definition: Autonomous coach coverage is the set of eligible V1 situations in which the integrated coach can produce a competent supported decision (including justified KEEP, bounded execution, suggestion, decision-changing ASK, or correctly scoped hold) using explicit inputs/recipes/authority. Correct clinical routing is measured separately from positive prescription. It is not100% never-abstains.
future_product_aspiration: A large majority of ordinary eligible situations should be handled competently without a human expert intervention; no90/95% gate is invented. Need distributional product baseline and expert assessment before quantifying.

denominators.warning: Designed situation counts are not natural event frequencies, independent replications or an empirical coverage rate. Positive prescribed capability and competent abstention are separate columns in future evaluation.

required_future_evaluation: Freeze target population, situations and normal/uncommon classification before sampling
Sample actual or independently designed held-out cases, including counterexamples and context/source failures
Count positive-prescription competence, no-op, decision-changing ASK, justified hold and inappropriate abstention separately
Assess rule compliance/goal quality/agency/meaningful failures with independent competent reviewers
Set quantitative release targets only after product baseline; no ratio from this designed set establishes majority
